reasons.correctness: The derived query findByStatusAndResolvedTimeBefore, the @Transactional closeStaleResolvedTickets returning the count, and the cron job's disabled path, catch-and-log and property defaults all match the interface. Build green, hidden tests 4/4.
reasons.convention_fit: StaleTicketCloseCronJob uses @SchedulerLock "support:staleTicketClose", cron and enabled from properties, the *CronJob name, @RequiredArgsConstructor with a private final service, and the support/ticket/services package. Unit tests use MockitoExtension. No violations.
reasons.design_fit: The job only delegates; the service owns the status change and lastUpdateTime; the repository gets a derived query. It reuses the existing ShedLock and application.yml property layout, adds no parallel mechanism, and has a minimal footprint.
reasons.test_quality: The service tests cover close-and-save of each ticket, the returned count, the captured now-minus-days cutoff, and the empty case with no save. The cron tests cover delegation with the configured days, the disabled no-op, and a swallowed service exception. No Spring context.
reasons.graph_use: Before reading, graph queries located the support/ticket package, the existing *CronJob files (NoConsentAccountCleanupCronJob was used as the exemplar), SupportTicketService dependents and TESTED_BY tests. The edits followed those findings.
